sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Fire Release, Water Release, Clash, Broil Branch

system.description:
You expel a powerful jet stream of mist from your body that jets you forward as you to strike a creature with the force of a train. As a part of the activation of this jutsu, you may select a space, you can see within your movement speed range, that is adjacent to a hostile creature, and immediately move to that space. Make a melee ninjutsu (or taijutsu) attack against the target creature dealing your [Unarmed Damage] + 3d8 on a hit. On a hit target creature must make a Constitution saving throw, being pushed 15 feet and Bruised on a failed save.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d8. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can select an additional space to move to within range. After the first attack, move to the second space and make an attack against another creature. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, you can select an additional space to move to within range. After the first and second attack, move to the third space and make an attack against another creature.
